horizon.outcome_reference: official close of first CM session on or after seven calendar days

universe.identity: current NSE company EQ master at issue time
universe.survivorship_guard: current-master identity is not historical universe proof

features.name: intraday_return_percent_rank
features.timestamp: same completed entry session; source first-observed before issue
features.missingness: exclude invalid or non-positive OHLC rows
features.transformation: cross-sectional percent rank of close/open minus one
features.reason: freeze a simple momentum baseline without outcome-driven tuning

features.name: liquidity_proxy_percent_rank
features.source: official NSE CM close and traded volume
features.timestamp: same completed entry session; source first-observed before issue
features.missingness: exclude rows below the fixed close-times-volume threshold
features.transformation: cross-sectional percent rank of close times volume
features.reason: reduce thin-instrument selection without claiming executable capacity

target.cost_assumption: no executable return claimed; execution costs remain NOT_PROVEN
target.action_policy: recapture actions at maturity; do not score until any action is resolved

next_experiment: At maturity, fetch official close and action sources without changing this version; score direction and benchmark excess only if provenance and adjustment checks pass.
